The plate spans about 355 px, so at roughly 26 cm that is about 0.073 cm per px. The food item is about 60 px wide and 215 px long, or roughly 4.4 cm by 15.7 cm. That fits a sausage or half of one, possibly a chorizo-style sausage or a hot dog.

Taking the thickness as about 3.5 cm and the cross-section as an ellipse, the volume is about π/4 × 4.4 × 3 × 15.7 ≈ 163 cm³. That seems too large for the shape in the photo, so I take the item as a bit thinner and shorter, about 100 g.

At roughly 300 kcal per 100 g for a sausage, that gives about 300 kcal. The orange color suggests chorizo or a similar sausage, so I settle on a mass of 90 g and about 290 kcal.
